_comment: Which browser journeys matter most, by e2e folder (QA task 19). P0: a customer cannot use the product without it, or it guards their data. P1: expected by customers. P2: operator or internal tooling. Every folder that holds a spec must be listed; tools/quality/check-browser-priority.mjs fails when one is not, so a new spec is classified the day it is added. The cross-browser run picks folders with E2E_PRIORITY=p0 or p0,p1.
